items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: The interviewee compares his brother Boynell to Lester ('He was not a good band man like Lester. See Lester was always a better band man than him'), indicating Lester is a known figure in the family's musical circle, but no direct personal interaction or relationship between Harold Dejan and Lester

ctx.x: When he was growing up, of course Lester's the only one in the family about except Pickett's wife that I know, was he bigger or smaller than Lester?
Oh yeah he was smaller than Lester, smaller than Lester and slimmer than Lester.
Was he a little darker or lighter?
